entries.proposition: The review treats fenfluramine as a drug obtained through repositioning and approved for two syndromes.
entries.snippet: Low-dose fenfluramine (FFA), which has come to the fore through drug repositioning, has emerged as a separate therapeutic option

entries.proposition: The pivotal Dravet evidence is two randomised double-blind placebo-controlled phase 3 studies, with effect seen early in titration and a dose-response pattern between the pre-set doses.
entries.snippet: In both studies, the effect of treatment was observed early in the dose titration phase and was maintained during the maintenance phase, with a clear dose-response pattern between the predetermined doses

entries.proposition: Time-based outcomes (longest seizure-free interval, time to first seizure) are reported as favouring the drug; the numbers in the review are rounded ranges taken from the primary trials, which were not available to this reader.
entries.snippet: Time-to-event analysis confirmed the magnitude of the effect: measures such as the longest seizure-free interval after baseline and time to first seizure favored FFA

entries.proposition: Open-label extension and real-world data are used as confirmation of durability, with retention and healthcare utilisation as outcomes.
entries.snippet: Open-label extension data confirm these results, showing sustained efficacy over several years

entries.proposition: The Lennox-Gastaut evidence is one randomised double-blind study of 263 patients.
entries.snippet: In a randomized, double-blind study involving 263 patients

entries.proposition: CDKL5 deficiency disorder: a six-patient open-label series and a phase 3 trial reported only as a company-level result, which the authors say must be interpreted cautiously until full peer review.
entries.snippet: however, these results should be interpreted cautiously until full peer-reviewed publication and regulatory evaluation are complete

entries.proposition: Sunflower syndrome observations are uncontrolled and short, with expectation bias named as a limitation.
entries.snippet: Important limitations remain—small sample sizes, lack of randomized comparators, short follow-up, and potential expectation bias

entries.proposition: The executive-function improvements come from post hoc analyses of a caregiver-rated inventory; the review says they are only partly attributable to seizure reduction.
entries.snippet: Multiple analytical approaches suggest that these EF improvements are only partially attributable to a reduction in seizures

entries.proposition: In Lennox-Gastaut the relation between change in fall seizures and change in the executive-function score is negligible to weak, and placebo-treated adults tended to worsen.
entries.snippet: correlations between changes in fall-associated seizures and changes in BRIEF-A scores were negligible to weak

entries.proposition: The authors class the executive-function findings as hypothesis-generating because they are post hoc and caregiver-rated, not performance-based, and ask for prospective confirmation.
entries.snippet: they should be interpreted as hypothesis-generating and should be confirmed prospectively

entries.proposition: Confounders named for caregiver-rated executive function: sedation, appetite and weight change, sleep consolidation and background polytherapy.
entries.snippet: potential confounder (sedation/drowsiness, appetite/weight change, sleep consolidation) and background polytherapy

entries.proposition: Internal tension: the introduction says valvulopathy and pulmonary hypertension have not been reported in the antiepileptic range, while the safety section says post-marketing cases exist.
entries.snippet: in epilepsy programs, valvulopathy or pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH) has not been reported in the antiepileptic dose range

entries.proposition: The safety section states that post-marketing experience has identified such cases and that monitoring remains essential.
entries.snippet: However, post-marketing experience has identified such cases, and therefore the continuous monitoring required by the label remains essential

entries.proposition: No direct comparative evidence between add-on drugs; the positioning claims rest on network comparisons with indirectness.
entries.snippet: although true, direct comparative evidence is still lacking

entries.proposition: Looking ahead the authors ask for confirmatory executive-function trials with objective endpoints.
entries.snippet: confirmatory EF trials with objective endpoints

entries.proposition: The authors declare a generative tool was used to improve language and readability.
entries.snippet: the authors used ChatGPT to improve language and readability
